findings.title: agentteams control stop reports STOP_TIMEOUT while a WebUI client socket is open
findings.observed: agentteams control stop --generation 1 exited 1 with "STOP_TIMEOUT: control pid=41072 did not exit after SIGTERM"; the daemon exited ~0.25s later and the state was consistent (state=stopped, pid gone, listener port closed)
findings.root_cause: the shutdown promise is server.close(() => resolveClose()) with no server.closeIdleConnections()/server.closeAllConnections(); server.close() only stops accepting and waits for existing sockets, so a live keep-alive/SSE client socket holds the process past the CLI's bounded wait
findings.minimal_repro: start a registry and a control daemon, open /api/v1/events twice (read one frame, reader.cancel() each), then agentteams control stop --config control.toml --generation <n> -> exit 1, STOP_TIMEOUT after ~5.17s, pid gone ~0.25s later. Variants measured: one SSE subscription -> clean stop in 269ms; zero -> 251ms; 30 pooled plain requests -> 227ms; reader.cancel(), controller.abort() and 5 pooled requests + 1 SSE all still reproduce it
findings.impact: a correct shutdown is reported as a failure to the operator; no history is lost (A09 retention holds) and agent-to-agent traffic is unaffected (A10 passes while the control daemon is down)

findings.title: the control daemon's projection can never carry real facts
findings.observed: /api/v1/projection is permanently {version:1, agents:[], sessions:[], notifications:[], configs:[], connections:[]}
findings.root_cause: the comment at runtime/control-process.ts:752-754 claims the daemon binds the owner from its own real network facts, but createControlOwner({ network: network.port }) passes no owner and the directory snapshot is hardcoded empty
findings.minimal_repro: start a control daemon and read /api/v1/projection with valid HTTP Basic credentials while agent peers are registered online; agents/sessions/notifications/configs stay empty
findings.impact: the shipped WebUI can never show real agents, sessions or notifications, which is why A07 is PARTIAL and gaps G1 and G3 exist
